# XLSX fixtures

`libreoffice.xlsx` was generated by LibreOffice Calc from this CSV:

``` csv
Header,Value
Template,1
```

Generation command:

``` sh
libreoffice --headless --convert-to xlsx --outdir test/fixtures libreoffice.csv
```

The integration test mutates this workbook with `pi-filler` and, when
LibreOffice is available, opens the resulting package by converting it
to CSV.
